newsitem.title: SPAIN: MOTOR RACING-VICTORY FOR VILLENEUVE IN SPANISH GRAND PRIX.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-VICTORY FOR VILLENEUVE IN SPANISH GRAND PRIX.

text.p: Canadian Jacques Villeneuve regained the leadership of the world drivers' championship on Sunday when he claimed a convincing victory for Williams in the Spanish Grand Prix.
Villeneuve, making the most of his pole position, took the lead immediately and controlled the race from the front, losing the lead only briefly when he made his pitstops.
He came home a comfortable five seconds clear of second-placed Frenchman Olivier Panis in a Prost. Jean Alesi of France was third in a Benetton.
Villeneuve's win was his third this season and the seventh of his career and took him to 30 points in the championship, ahead of Germany's Michael Schumacher on 27.
Ferrari driver Schumacher finished fourth ahead of Britons Johnny Herbert in a Sauber and David Coulthard in a McLaren.
Villeneuve's win came after two races without a point but it was a bad day again for his team mate Heinz-Harald Frentzen of Germany. After starting second on the grid, Frentzen finished eighth.
